title: Synthetic Dataset Generation Pipeline
summary: A memory-safe pipeline that anonymises and transforms large-scale UK primary care (SystmOne) clinical tables and generates relationally consistent synthetic patient datasets with post-generation clone-detection privacy auditing. It runs SDV's HMASynthesizer, with a Metadata object and temporal constraints, to synthesize the multi-table clinical data.
